title: S&P DJI March quarterly rebalance takes effect at the open — S&P 500/100/400/600 membership, share and float changes implemented at the 2027-03-19 close
source: EST: the index owner's own effective-date wording, RE-SOURCED THIS SESSION FROM TWO MARCH INSTANCES — the quarter this family had never read. The proposal inherited a rule established across four December instances; this initial research replaced that with releases from the actual month, both fetched direct from S&P Dow Jones Indices' own newsroom 2026-09-09, HTTP 200: (1) press.spglobal.com/2025-03-07-DoorDash,-TKO-Group-Holdings,-Williams-Sonoma-and-Expand-Energy-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-... (92,611 bytes) — verbatim, S&P DJI 'will make the following changes to the S&P 100, S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600 indices effective prior to the open of trading on Monday, March 24, to coincide with the quarterly rebalance', where the third Friday of March 2025 was 2025-03-21; (2) press.spglobal.com/2026-03-06-Vertiv-Holdings,-Lumentum-Holdings,-Coherent,-and-EchoStar-Set-to-Join-S-P-500-... (94,408 bytes) — 'The following changes to the S&P 100, S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, and S&P SmallCap 600 will take effect before the market opens on Monday, March 23, as part of the quarterly rebalance', with 58 index-action rows stamped 'Mar 23, 2026', where the third Friday of March 2026 was 2026-03-20. Both locate the effective open on the Monday following that quarter's third Friday. NOTE FOR THE NEXT LANE IN THIS FAMILY: the owner PARAPHRASES the sentence — 2026 reads 'will take effect before the market opens on … as part of the quarterly rebalance' where 2025 and every instance the December sibling read say 'effective prior to the open of trading on … to coincide with the quarterly rebalance' — so a grep for the 2025 phrasing silently misses the 2026 release. A SEC-FILED PRIMARY NAMES MARCH EXPLICITLY and was re-fetched this session rather than inherited: SEC EDGAR, Select Sector SPDR Trust Form 497 (accession 0001193125-26-031948, d85739d497.htm, HTTP 200, 2,388,335 bytes, 2026-09-09) — 'The rebalancing of the Select Sector Indices, based on the processes described above, occurs at the closing prices of the second Friday of March, June, September and December. Changes will become effective after the market close on the third Friday of March, June, September and December.' Applied to March 2027: the Fridays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th, so the third Friday is 2027-03-19 — already tracked as opex-2027-03-19 — and the rebalance is effective prior to the open on MONDAY 2027-03-22, implemented at the 2027-03-19 close. THE METHODOLOGY PRIMARY WAS ATTEMPTED AGAIN AND IS STILL BLOCKED: spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/methodologies/methodology-sp-us-indices.pdf returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-09 (recorded in this event's ledger probe-ref.blocked), so no rebalancing-schedule clause was read from the methodology itself and nothing was silently substituted. Stays estimate on two counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no member for an index owner's own published schedule (the same gap every sibling rebalance and Russell entry records), and no 2027-dated S&P DJI release exists yet — the March 2027 release is due around 2027-03-05. THE DATE IS NOT IN DOUBT; the estimate label is about the taxonomy and the missing instance, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), which read the single proposal carrying this id (proposals/sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-03-31.json) in full first and then re-sourced the effective-date rule from the March quarter specifically. Ledger: docs/research/events/sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-03-22.md. MARCH IS THE CLEAN QUARTER, AND THAT IS THIS ENTRY'S REASON TO EXIST. The December sibling (sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2027-12-20) closed by recording that in December 'the month is the confound' and that its two candidate findings both died against same-window placebos; the September sibling (sp-quarterly-rebalance-effective-2026-09-21) measured the index-level null and the constituent-level effect but ran its execution statistic on the POOLED quarterly sample. March carries no annual reconstitution overlay and no holiday seasonal, so it is the one leg where a same-month control is both available and meaningful — and this session ran it. WHAT SURVIVES: the March implementation Friday is a real volume event that holds up against its own month. SPY volume over its own trailing-60 median on the 22 March third Fridays 2005-2026 runs 1.496x mean / 1.291x median, ABOVE 1.0x IN 19 OF 22, against 1.297x / 1.097x for all other March sessions (n=437) at Mann-Whitney p=2.64%. That is the first time this family's execution caution has cleared a same-month control on any quarterly leg. It does NOT separate March from the other quarterly legs (p=44.0%) and only weakly from ordinary monthly-opex Fridays at March's own n=22 (p=8.27%), so the hazard is quarterly-sized, not March-sized. WHAT DIED, AND THE KILL IS THE TRANSFERABLE PART: two candidate findings were raised and both were refuted by controls this session built. (i) A March effective-open relative-volume step looked real — 1.185x mean / 1.086x median, 14 of 22 above 1.0x, against 0.975x / 0.899x and 21 of 64 for the Jun/Sep/Dec legs (MW p=8.68%) — until the within-March control: MW p=25.5% against other March sessions, whose median relative volume (1.097x) is HIGHER than the legs'. The cause is the denominator. March is the highest-mean relative-volume month of the twelve (1.301x mean / 1.098x median vs 1.098x / 0.988x for all sessions, MW p<0.001%) because a trailing-60 window ending mid-March straddles the Christmas and New Year lull. That is the exact MIRROR of the December sibling's caution that Thanksgiving inflates December ratios — generalized here: the trailing-60 denominator is seasonally biased in BOTH directions, and only a same-month or same-window control is safe. (ii) A small-cap tier tilt on the effective open looked real — IJR minus SPY total return, mean +0.209%, median +0.408%, MW p=3.95% against the Jun/Sep/Dec legs, monotone in tier (IJR > IJH > SPY, with equal-weight RSP flat at p=49.5%) — and it dies twice. Its sign test never fired (14 of 22 positive, p=28.6%), and the per-quarter split shows the MW result is an artefact of comparing March's +0.408% against SEPTEMBER's -0.195%: pooling the two quarters whose legs implement two sessions after an FOMC decision (March and September) against the two that do not (June and December) gives p=49.2%, and the same pooling on SPY returns gives p=87.3%. Four quarters, four medians of alternating sign, no bucket significant on its own — the signature of noise across four n~22 samples. DECISIVELY, THERE IS NO FLOW FOOTPRINT: IJR's relative volume on the effective open is indistinguishable from SPY's (MW p=92.9%) and from other quarters. Index flow moves turnover before it moves price, so a return tilt with no turnover signature cannot be rebalance flow. THE ONE GENUINELY 2027-SPECIFIC STRUCTURAL FACT: Easter 2027 is unusually early, so Good Friday falls on 2027-03-26 — the FOURTH Friday of March, one week after this rebalance implements — and the market is closed (NYSE's own holiday calendar, nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct 2026-09-09, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes; its Good Friday row parses as Friday April 3 / Friday March 26 / Friday April 14 for 2026 / 2027 / 2028, independently reproducing the tracked good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 entry). So the effective week is FOUR sessions, Mon 2027-03-22 through Thu 2027-03-25, not five. Only 2 of the 22 March legs since 2005 share that configuration (2005 and 2016; the next after 2027 is 2032), and they disagree by a factor of two on week relative volume (1.235x vs 0.613x) — named and REFUSED ON POWER, n=2 is not a sample. What does not need the statistic: Holy Weeks generally run quiet (median 0.982x relative volume across 80 sessions), so whatever the rebalance leaves unfinished on 2027-03-19 has four thin sessions before a closure rather than five ordinary ones. NO EQUITY EARLY CLOSE APPLIES: the same NYSE page names no March 2027 early close — the 2:00 p.m. ET Thursday 2027-03-25 early close already tracked as sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25 is fixed income only. A 2008 PRECEDENT IS RECORDED SO NOBODY ASSUMES A COLLISION: in 2008 Good Friday fell ON the March third Friday (2008-03-21), so implementation moved to the Thursday 2008-03-20 close and the effective open was Monday 2008-03-24. 2027 does not collide — Good Friday is the fourth Friday. A STRUCTURAL ASYMMETRY WORTH CARRYING, computed from this repo's own FOMC entries: the March and September quarterly legs implement TWO days after an FOMC decision (2026-09-16/09-18, 2027-03-17/03-19, 2027-09-15/09-17) while the June and December legs implement nine days after (2026-12-09/12-18, 2027-06-09/06-18, 2027-12-08/12-17). fomc-2027-03-17 is thus the corridor's heaviest item and the normal March configuration, not a 2027 anomaly — and as leg 5 shows, it explains nothing about the effective open. ONE DATED ADJACENT PROPOSED: sp-rebalance-proforma-2027-03-05, the March 2027 announcement and pro-forma release, on the first-Friday-of-the-rebalance-month convention that both March instances re-fetched here follow (2025-03-07 and 2026-03-06 are each the first Friday of their month) and that the calendar already tracks for two other quarters as sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-09-04 and sp-rebalance-proforma-2026-12-04. ONE DELIBERATELY DECLINED: a capped-pro-forma entry for 2027-03-12, because that date already carries sp-rebalance-reference-close-2027-03-12 and the December sibling's precedent is not to file a second market-structure entry onto a session already tracked. Symbols deliberately EMPTY, following both siblings: what moves at a rebalance is individual constituents, and the March 2027 roster will not exist until S&P DJI publishes around 2027-03-05. Kind 'sector' matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; EventKind has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane. Filed estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
